Chapter 603: Chapter 32: Over Six Hundred Years (Subscription Request)_2

Chapter 603: Chapter 32: Over Six Hundred Years (Subscription Request)_2

Similar to those special life forms, compared to normal beings of the same level.

This is a gap derived from depth.

There’s no helping it, with the same attack, your inner world is about to collapse, teetering on the brink.

Yet the inner world of a Ninth Stage Martial Tao Evolver merely shook briefly before returning to normal.

“Divine Lattice, world structure, and bloodline evolution path are the three major gains from this traversal,”

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

...

There’s no need to discuss the importance of the first two. As for the bloodline evolution path, although it has many drawbacks, it also depends on the specific circumstances.

In the Main World, countless citizens have too low a comprehension, dull to the rule fluctuations of the outside world, which makes the bloodline evolution path quite suitable.

Of course, the prerequisite is that there must be sufficiently strong bloodlines within the body.

But nonetheless, it’s still a path, much stronger than spending a lifetime unable to become an Evolver.

“Perhaps the bloodline evolution path can also be integrated into Martial Tao? Similar to how Body Cultivation was integrated before?”

Lin Yuan pondered in his heart.

The bloodline evolution path is not a specific evolution path; it’s more like a method to use the power of one’s own bloodline to enhance strength.

In the Main World, there are many bloodline evolution families, but their excavation of bloodlines is not as perfected as in this World.

After all, in the Main World’s human civilization, the bloodline evolution path is just a niche, with its upper limits easily capped. To become a true powerhouse, one still needs to follow the understanding of rules path.

“Take it slow.”

“There’s still plenty of time, with most of the stay remaining.”

Lin Yuan gathered his thoughts and looked down below.

Longshan Ling had arrived.

…

Outside the Longshan Great Hall.

Many members of the Longshan Family were still patiently waiting.

They could feel that the great Longshan Patriarch, Longshan Yuan, was still not dead, alive and well.

Just then.

A figure appeared silently before the great hall.

“Patriarch.”

“Patriarch, you’ve returned?”

Longshan Ling and a few close subordinates were the first to react, quickly greeting him respectfully.

“Hmm…..”

Lin Yuan glanced at the many excited faces of the Longshan Family members.

“Patriarch, about the matter in the sky…” Longshan Ling mustered the courage to ask carefully.

“I did it,” Lin Yuan answered directly, as there was no longer any need to hide; he was already invincible in the world, why bother concealing and being low-key?

“Is it really…” With Lin Yuan’s personal admission, Longshan Ling and the other members of the Longshan Family were stunned.

Even though they had speculated about this possibility, when it was actually confirmed, they still found it incredible.

Is the Patriarch this powerful?

“There’s one more thing.” Lin Yuan’s mind moved, and a figure was teleported out.

It was the Pope of the Rank Church.

To be precise, it was this Pope’s divine persona located in the Ocean of Light.

This time, as Lin Yuan slaughtered the gods, this subordinate deity was the only one left alive.

As for the reason, naturally, it was because Lin Yuan had been in good relations with him over the years.

Moreover, the Rank Pope had only the strength of a Lower-Rank God. With the death of the Main God of Rank, as a subordinate deity, his power plummeted, probably barely reaching the threshold of a True God.

And as a subordinate deity, his power was fixed, with no chance of further enhancement.

Actually, if not for Lin Yuan intentionally saving him, at the moment of the Main God of Rank’s death, the Rank Pope should have been annihilated by backlash already.

“Longshan Patriarch…” The Rank Pope looked at Lin Yuan with a complex gaze.

He had witnessed the complete scene of Lin Yuan slaughtering the gods in the Ocean of Light. At this moment, surprisingly, the Rank Pope felt no fear whatsoever.

Because fear was meaningless; if Lin Yuan wanted him dead, the Rank Pope had no hope of survival.

“You can leave now,” Lin Yuan stated, with no intention of killing the Rank Pope.

A mere subordinate divine spirit had no allure for Lin Yuan, nor would it pose any threat to the Longshan Family in the future.

“Thank you, Longshan Patriarch, for sparing my life,” the Rank Pope exhaled deeply, mysteriously feeling sentimental.

Under the twilight of the gods, all deities perished, even the strongest Prime God had died, who would have thought that he, as the weakest subordinate divine spirit, would actually survive?

The strongest had died.

The weakest still lived.

The Rank Pope had complex thoughts.

“Longshan Patriarch…” the Rank Pope silently recited in his heart, knowing that his survival was solely due to the Longshan Patriarch’s mercy.

“In the future, it will be the era of the Longshan Patriarch,” the Rank Pope thought as he left Longshan Ling, a new thought suddenly emerging in his mind.

Since the Prime God of Light opened the Ocean of Light, the era of the gods officially began.

Even the powerful gods like the Prime God of Light and Dark God dared not place their divine names before the era.

But from now on, the name of the Longshan Patriarch will completely dominate the era, even if a hundred thousand or a billion years pass, the later beings and gods will still fear the reputation of the Longshan Patriarch.

…

Outside the Longshan Great Hall.

Lin Yuan looked towards Longshan Ling and the others.

“Next, I will leave the human realm,” Lin Yuan said.

“Leave the human realm?” Longshan Ling and other important members of the Longshan Family glanced at each other, now standing before Lin Yuan, all feeling a certain pressure from the essence of life.

“Patriarch, where do you plan to go? The Ocean of Light, or the Dark Abyss?” Longshan Ling asked softly.

“I will go to the Martial Realm,” Lin Yuan said with a faint smile.

“The Martial Realm?” Many members of the Longshan Family looked puzzled, hearing about this place for the first time.

“Where is the Martial Realm?” Longshan Ling asked cautiously.

“Over there,” Lin Yuan raised his right hand, slicing through the space, and an intact layer of space emerged.

Lin Yuan stepped into it, with Longshan Ling and many members of the Longshan Family watching in awe, as he began to calm the spatial turbulence.

Where Lin Yuan stood, everything stabilized, the energy became gentle, and space became steady, accompanied by a thick ground and sky.

Rumble, rumble.

A world far surpassing the Ocean of Light and the Dark Abyss was opened, its impact so significant that it even began to reflect in the human world.

“Who is that…”

“Someone is opening a new world, just like the original Prime God of Light and Dark God opened the Ocean of Light and Dark Abyss.”

“This person must be the one who ended the era of the gods, now creating a world, likely as his own dwelling.”

…

In the human realm, ancient Demigods had not yet recovered from the fall of the gods, when they witnessed such a shocking sight.

…

After over four hours, Lin Yuan finally stabilized this layer of space, nodding in satisfaction, “The foundation is almost laid down, for now, this will do.”

Within his own new world, Lin Yuan finally felt much more comfortable, under the influence of numerous spatial layers, he felt a long-missed sense of freedom.

“I should also inform the beings,” Lin Yuan glanced at the vast human realm, directly manifesting a towering presence, “From today, the Martial Realm has been created, any who reach godhood through Martial Tao Cultivation Skill may enter the Martial Realm.”

Having declared to the human realm, Lin Yuan did not care how much disturbance it caused, and returned once more to the Martial Realm, sitting at its very center.

“Finally, I can quietly cultivate and understand the Dao again,” Lin Yuan said.

Lin Yuan took out many Divine Lattices.

“Twenty-four True God Forms, three thousand sixty-three Upper-Rank God Divine Lattices, twenty-nine thousand six hundred forty-two Middle-Rank God Divine Lattices, one hundred twenty-three thousand two hundred forty-two Lower-Rank God Divine Lattices…”

Lin Yuan felt joy wash over him just by looking at the pile of Divine Lattices, feeling many spiritual insights surge forth, now beginning to earnestly understand them.

“I wonder how much strength these Divine Lattices will add to me…” Lin Yuan thought, relying on the Divine Lattices of those Demigods in the human realm to open up to one hundred twenty million spatial layers.

What about the True Divine Nature?

And the True God Form?

“Let’s start understanding,” Lin Yuan casually picked up a Divine Lattice, this one containing the property of space, the ‘key’ to the higher essence of space in this universe.

…

Just like that.

Time swiftly passed.

Six hundred years had gone by in the blink of an eye.
